_comment: Manual corrections applied on top of rovmeta.com by scripts/fetch_items.py. Each entry replaces (or adds) the item with the same slug. Values come from official patch notes (Garena TH https://www.rov.in.th/patch-notes and Garena TW https://moba.garena.tw/news, which lists exact numbers). TW text is translated from Traditional Chinese to English.

items.name: Stealth Bracer
passives: Active - Untrackable: Instantly become invisible for 2.5s (1s for melee heroes), gaining 30% movement speed and restoring 130~260 HP every 0.5s. Using a skill or normal attack ends invisibility. Cooldown 75s.

items.name: Light Shield
passives: Passive - Daybreak: Damaging an enemy hero with a normal attack or skill grants a shield of 250~500 (+4% max HP) to yourself and the lowest-HP nearby ally for 3s (+50% shield with no ally nearby). Cooldown 10s melee / 12.5s ranged.

items.name: Mail of Pain
passives: Unique Passive - Backfire: When taking damage, reflect 5% of it to the attacker as true damage (based on the raw damage before damage reduction; decays with distance by up to 50%).
Active - Counter-stab: Increase Backfire reflection to 25% for 3s. Cooldown 75s.
Unique Passive - Insatiable: Gains invincibility and temporary damage immunity and increases attack and movement speed by 25% for 1.25 seconds. (Cooldown: 120 seconds)
items.patch: Beta 55 (1.25s from EXP server 4 Sep 2026; TW 24 Sep notice fixes the upgraded Death Sickle duration on live)
Innovation Era version, Jan 2026 (rovmeta merged passive text into stats)

Active - Resonance: Unlocks after collecting 600 gold. Target an allied hero; you and the ally gain 200 gold and 200 EXP in total (once per match).
